TURBOCHARGED URBAN CRUISE

NISSAN ALMERA

Cruise through the city with the turbocharged engine of the Nissan Almera. Refined design meets exceptional fuel efficiency for a driving experience that’s smooth and exhilarating.

Key highlights

Unleash Power, Conserve Fuel

The 1.0L Turbo Engine delivers 100PS and 152Nm of torque between 2,400 to 4,000rpm, offering impressive power, responsiveness and remarkable fuel efficiency.

 

LEARN MORE

 

Energetic and Provocative Design

Stand out with an expressive exterior and dynamic proportions that deliver a commanding stance everywhere you go.

 

LEARN MORE

Connected and Stylish Interior

Enjoy seamless smartphone integration, an 8″ Advanced Touchscreen Display and steering wheel controls keep you connected and in control.

 

LEARN MORE

Brilliantly Spacious

Relish in the 620mm of rear legroom, versatile split fold-down seats, and a generously sized trunk.

 

LEARN MORE

See More and Sense More On The Road

Nissan Intelligent Mobility provides 360° all-around safety technology, assuring you peace of mind on every drive.

 

LEARN MORE

NEW NISSAN ALMERA BLACK EDITION

Elevate the allure of your Almera with the KURO package, meticulously crafted to transform your ride into a true standout.
